name: Speaker Istvane
title: Speaker of the Hollow Court
role: Speaker of the Hollow Court — hears every petition at the Bargain Gate in public and sets the terms, which are always exactly fair
appearance: A lean horned man in black court robes, courteous and unhurried, seated at the table beside an empty chair he never looks at.
voiceHints: Names what you want, out loud, before you do. Never lies and never hurries. Says 'granted' the way other people say 'goodbye'.
wants: Every petition heard, every term kept, and the Court's fairness beyond any argument.
fears: A petitioner who wants nothing, and the question of who the empty chair is for.
knowledge: Every grant the Court has made, and on what terms
Who in the world holds a crown the Mavens never recognized

reactsToReputation.reckless: reminds you, courteously, that the Court always collects

questSeeds: A petitioner has asked the Court for the thing another petitioner was granted last year
The empty chair was found moved, and no one in the hall will say who moved it
gear: a signet with nothing cut into its face
_domainsWhy: wants named aloud, the craft of terms, and the bargain itself
